Title: MediaTrack Class
Key Concepts: Classes; properties; methods; constructors; ToString()
Expected Outcome: Create a reusable MediaTrack model for music and karaoke files.
Notes: Initial challenge.

Title: Library Scanner
Key Concepts: Directory traversal; collections; dictionaries; case-insensitive extensions
Expected Outcome: Recursively scan folders and identify supported media files.
Notes: Completed before roadmap v1.0 snapshot.

Title: Karaoke File Pairing
Key Concepts: File matching; path handling; collections; modelling relationships
Expected Outcome: Pair CDG files with matching audio files and report incomplete pairs.
Notes: Completed before Milestone 1.

Title: Media Type Detection
Key Concepts: Enums; switch expressions; file extensions; case-insensitive classification
Expected Outcome: Classify supported media files as audio, karaoke graphics, or unsupported.
Notes: Final implementation uses MediaFileType and MediaTypeDetector.

Title: File Validation
Key Concepts: Guard clauses; nullable reference types; validation; file existence
Expected Outcome: Validate paths and media files cleanly before processing them.
Notes: Reuses Media Type Detection through a project reference.

Title: Media Library
Key Concepts: List<T>; encapsulation; add/remove/find operations
Expected Outcome: Manage scanned MediaTrack objects through a dedicated library class.
Notes: Introduced reusable MediaLibrary collection management.

Title: Media Library Queries
Key Concepts: LINQ; Where; Any; IEnumerable<T>; lambda expressions; case-insensitive searching
Expected Outcome: Query the media library by artist, title, filename, file path, and extension.
Notes: Implemented as MediaLibraryQueries static service.

Title: Media Library Filtering
Key Concepts: LINQ query syntax; IEnumerable<T>; filtering; where; select
Expected Outcome: Filter music and karaoke tracks by karaoke status and duration.
Notes: Practised LINQ query syntax through MediaLibraryFilterService.

Title: Track Sorting
Key Concepts: LINQ sorting; OrderBy; ThenBy; IComparer<T>; custom comparison
Expected Outcome: Sort tracks by artist/title, title, and duration using LINQ and a custom comparer.
Notes: Includes ArtistTitleComparer with case-insensitive comparison.

Title: Duplicate Detection
Key Concepts: HashSet<T>; IEqualityComparer<T>; custom equality; Equals(); GetHashCode(); case-insensitive comparison
Expected Outcome: Identify duplicate and distinct tracks using artist/title equality rules.
Notes: Uses ArtistTitleEqualityComparer and DuplicateDetectionService.

Title: Media Library Processor
Key Concepts: Integration; IEnumerable<T>; filtering; sorting; duplicate detection; code reuse
Expected Outcome: Combine duplicate detection, filtering, sorting, and presentation into a coherent media library processing workflow.
Notes: Milestone 1 completed; integration challenge and milestone quiz completed.

Title: Media Metadata Model
Key Concepts: Records/classes; nullable properties; metadata fields; immutability
Expected Outcome: Represent title, artist, album, genre, year, track number, duration, and technical metadata.
Notes: Implemented using an immutable record with required file path, nullable metadata fields, value equality and with expressions.

Title: Read Embedded Audio Metadata
Key Concepts: NuGet packages; third-party APIs; MP3/FLAC/Opus tags; resource disposal
Expected Outcome: Read embedded metadata from supported audio files using a suitable metadata library.
Notes: Implemented using TagLibSharp; tested with MP3 metadata and technical audio properties.

Title: Filename Metadata Fallback
Key Concepts: String parsing; regular expressions; TryParse-style APIs
Expected Outcome: Extract artist/title from filenames when embedded tags are missing.
Notes: Implemented filename fallback for artist, title and track number while preserving available embedded metadata.

Title: Metadata Resolution
Key Concepts: Fallback rules; null handling; precedence; pure functions
Expected Outcome: Choose the best metadata from embedded tags, filenames, and defaults.
Notes: Implemented metadata precedence using embedded values first, filename-derived fallbacks, whitespace handling and nullable value resolution.

Title: Metadata Reader Interface
Key Concepts: Interfaces; abstraction; dependency inversion
Expected Outcome: Wrap the third-party metadata package behind an application-owned IMetadataReader.
Notes: Introduced IMetadataReader and EmbeddedMetadata, moved TagLibSharp-specific reading into TagLibMetadataReader, and refactored MediaMetadataScanner to depend on the interface.

Title: Metadata Resolution Tests
Key Concepts: Test project; assertions; parameterized tests; edge cases
Expected Outcome: Introduce automated tests around deterministic metadata and filename rules.
Notes: Added xUnit test project with 15 passing tests covering metadata precedence, filename fallback, parameterized cases, exceptions, fake metadata readers, and temporary-file cleanup.

Title: Scan Result Model
Key Concepts: Records; result objects; warnings/errors; separation of concerns
Expected Outcome: Return structured scan results rather than mixing scanning with console output.
Notes: Uses an explicit IsSuccess flag; failed scans use null metadata, while warnings represent non-fatal issues.

Title: Exception Handling & Error Reporting
Key Concepts: Exceptions; try/catch; custom exceptions; recoverable failures
Expected Outcome: Handle inaccessible folders, corrupt metadata, and missing files without crashing the whole scan.
Notes: Introduced MediaScanService with structured ScanResult error handling for missing files, invalid metadata, access failures and unexpected exceptions; added non-fatal metadata warnings and batch scanning that continues after individual failures.

Title: Scan Statistics
Key Concepts: GroupBy; aggregates; percentages; summaries
Expected Outcome: Produce useful statistics about supported files, failures, karaoke pairs, and metadata quality.
Notes: Added scan success/failure summaries, warning totals, file-extension grouping, metadata completeness statistics, and matched/unmatched karaoke pairing statistics.

Title: Metadata Library Milestone
Key Concepts: Integration; refactoring; test coverage; service boundaries
Expected Outcome: Create a scanner that produces resolved metadata and useful diagnostics for a real library.
Notes: Integrated library discovery, metadata scanning, diagnostics, karaoke pairing and scan statistics into a single workflow; separated metadata-capable audio files from CDG pairing files; tested against a mixed real library of 859 supported files with 714 successful metadata scans and 145 matched karaoke pairs.

Title: Configuration File
Key Concepts: System.Text.Json; serialization; deserialization; defaults
Expected Outcome: Store application settings and library locations in JSON.
Notes: Added AppConfiguration and ConfigurationLoader; integrated JSON configuration into the Metadata Library Milestone.

Title: Configuration Validation
Key Concepts: Validation; defaults; nullable reference types; error messages
Expected Outcome: Load configuration safely and recover from missing or invalid settings.
Notes: Added ConfigurationValidator; separated loading failures from validation failures; integrated validation into the Metadata Library Milestone.

Title: Multiple Library Sources
Key Concepts: Collections; configuration models; source types; disconnected drives
Expected Outcome: Support multiple enabled/disabled music and karaoke source folders.
Notes: Added LibrarySource and LibrarySourceType with Music, Karaoke and Mixed source types; configuration now supports multiple enabled/disabled sources, readable JSON enum values, case-insensitive duplicate-path validation, combined scanning across available sources, and graceful handling of unavailable drives.

Title: Source-Specific Scan Rules
Key Concepts: Enums; switch logic; filtering; configuration-driven behaviour; separation of concerns; unit testing
Expected Outcome: Apply different scanning rules to Music, Karaoke, and Mixed library sources.
Notes: Added LibrarySourceRulesService to apply source-specific karaoke processing rules; Music sources exclude files from karaoke pairing, Karaoke sources include all discovered files, and Mixed sources include matched MP3/CDG pairs plus unmatched CDG files while allowing standalone MP3 files as valid music; added a dedicated xUnit test project with 6 passing tests covering source behaviour, directory-aware pairing and case-insensitive extensions.

Title: Playlist Model
Key Concepts: Collections; ordering; encapsulation; identifiers; unit testing
Expected Outcome: Create and manipulate playlists containing library tracks.
Notes: Added an in-memory Playlist model with Guid identity, ordered MediaTrackModel storage, read-only track access, count, add/remove/clear operations and boolean removal results; duplicate playlist entries remain permitted to support different recordings and repeated tracks; added a dedicated xUnit test project with 6 passing tests covering collection behaviour, ordering, removal and clearing.

Title: M3U Playlist Import & Export
Key Concepts: Text formats; relative/absolute paths; import/export
Expected Outcome: Read and write common M3U playlists.
Notes: Implemented M3U reader and writer with relative/absolute path support, 11 automated tests, round-trip verification, and manual VLC/Winamp interoperability testing.

Title: Playback Queue Manager
Key Concepts: Queue-like behaviour; ordering; mutation; state
Expected Outcome: Maintain an editable ordered playback queue.
Notes: Added PlaybackQueue with enqueue, queue-next, peek, dequeue, remove and clear operations; preserves queue ordering and exposes queued tracks through a read-only collection; added a dedicated xUnit test project with 12 passing tests covering queue state, ordering, mutation and empty-queue behaviour, plus a console demo for manual verification.

Title: Playback History & Play Counts
Key Concepts: Collections; LINQ; timestamps; counters; domain methods
Expected Outcome: Track recently played songs, last-played time, and play counts.
Notes: Added PlaybackHistoryManager and PlaybackHistoryEntry to record in-memory playback events, calculate play counts and last-played timestamps, return newest-first history, validate track paths, and provide dedicated xUnit tests plus a console demo for manual verification.

Title: Favourites
Key Concepts: Flags/state; serialization; identifiers
Expected Outcome: Mark favourite tracks and preserve that preference.
Notes: Added FavouriteManager with duplicate-safe favourite state, validation and read-only access; added FavouriteStore for JSON save/load persistence, missing-file handling and invalid JSON behaviour; added dedicated xUnit tests plus a console demo verifying favourite state persists across application runs.

Title: Smart Lists
Key Concepts: Predicates; reusable rules; composition; queries
Expected Outcome: Generate dynamic lists such as favourites, unplayed tracks, or karaoke-only selections.
Notes: Added SmartListRule with predicate-based matching and validation; added SmartList with ordered rule management and read-only access; added SmartListService using LINQ Where and All with AND semantics; added 22 passing xUnit tests covering validation, rule behaviour and filtering, plus a console demo using modern C# syntax.

Title: Advanced Search & Filter Rules
Key Concepts: Generics; predicates; All/Any matching; rule composition; reusable filters; input validation
Expected Outcome: Combine reusable search and filter rules using generic smart lists, configurable matching modes, rule composition, and existing sorting services.
Notes: Extended Smart Lists with generic rule composition, configurable All/Any matching, reusable MediaTrackRules for search and filtering, and integration with existing media library sorting; expanded automated coverage across the Smart Lists project.

Title: Search & Playlist Milestone
Key Concepts: Application composition; dependency injection; cross-project integration; mapping; integration testing; targeted refactoring
Expected Outcome: Produce a usable in-memory media library with configuration, search, playlists, favourites, and playback history.
Notes: Integrated configuration-driven library scanning, source-specific rules, metadata mapping, media library building, smart-list filtering, sorting, favourites, playlist creation, M3U import/export and library resolution, playback queue, and playback history; extracted LibrarySourceRulesService into a reusable project; added focused and cross-project integration tests; manually verified against both a small mixed library and the full library.

Title: JSON Library Persistence
Key Concepts: Serialization; file IO; DTOs; versioning
Expected Outcome: Save and reload a modest media library without rescanning.

Title: SQLite Fundamentals
Key Concepts: SQLite; tables; primary keys; INSERT; SELECT; UPDATE; DELETE
Expected Outcome: Learn relational persistence using a small standalone SQLite database.

Title: Media Library Database Schema
Key Concepts: Normalization; keys; indexes; relationships; constraints
Expected Outcome: Design tables for tracks, sources, playlists, history, and related application data.

Title: Database Data Access Layer
Key Concepts: Repository/data access pattern; parameterized SQL; interfaces
Expected Outcome: Keep SQL/database concerns separate from library business logic.

Title: Persist Scanned Tracks
Key Concepts: Transactions; upserts; identity; batching
Expected Outcome: Store scan results and resolved metadata in SQLite.

Title: Database-backed Search
Key Concepts: WHERE; ORDER BY; LIKE; indexes; query parameters
Expected Outcome: Search and filter a large library efficiently from SQLite.

Title: Incremental Library Scan
Key Concepts: File timestamps; hashes/identifiers; change detection; upserts
Expected Outcome: Scan only files that are new or changed rather than rebuilding the whole library.

Title: Library Reconciliation
Key Concepts: Set comparison; missing files; stale records; transactions
Expected Outcome: Detect deleted, moved, and unavailable tracks and reconcile them with stored records.

Title: FileSystemWatcher Library Updates
Key Concepts: FileSystemWatcher; debounce; events; race conditions
Expected Outcome: React to library file changes without requiring a full manual rescan.

Title: Database & Persistence Tests
Key Concepts: Temporary databases; integration tests; fixtures; cleanup
Expected Outcome: Verify database and incremental-scan behaviour with repeatable tests.

Title: Persistent Library Milestone
Key Concepts: Architecture review; performance measurement; refactoring
Expected Outcome: Build a database-backed library that survives restarts and updates efficiently.

Title: Async Library Scanner
Key Concepts: async/await; Task; asynchronous IO; ConfigureAwait concepts
Expected Outcome: Run potentially slow scanning work without blocking the application.

Title: Scan Progress Reporting
Key Concepts: IProgress<T>; progress models; event-driven updates
Expected Outcome: Report scan progress independently of console or UI code.

Title: Cancellation Support
Key Concepts: CancellationToken; cooperative cancellation; cleanup
Expected Outcome: Safely cancel a long-running library scan.

Title: Application Events & Delegates
Key Concepts: Events; delegates; EventHandler<T>; subscriptions
Expected Outcome: Publish library and playback state changes without tight coupling.

Title: Service Interfaces
Key Concepts: Interfaces; dependency inversion; service contracts
Expected Outcome: Define clean boundaries for scanning, metadata, library, playlists, and playback services.

Title: Dependency Injection
Key Concepts: DI container; constructor injection; lifetimes; composition root
Expected Outcome: Compose application services without manually constructing dependencies everywhere.

Title: Performance Profiling
Key Concepts: Stopwatch; benchmarking concepts; allocations; query timing
Expected Outcome: Measure scanner, metadata, and database performance on realistic library sizes.

Title: Broader Unit & Integration Testing
Key Concepts: Mocks/fakes; integration boundaries; test design; regression tests
Expected Outcome: Expand automated coverage across the main application services.

Title: Application Architecture Milestone
Key Concepts: Layering; dependency review; testability; maintainability
Expected Outcome: Refactor the growing codebase into a clean application core ready for a desktop UI.

Title: Playback State Model
Key Concepts: Enums; state transitions; timestamps; domain modelling
Expected Outcome: Represent stopped, playing, paused, position, duration, and current track state.

Title: Player Commands
Key Concepts: Command methods; validation; state transitions; interfaces
Expected Outcome: Implement play, pause, stop, next, previous, and seek behaviour at the application layer.

Title: Karaoke Track Model
Key Concepts: Composition; optional components; invariants; equality
Expected Outcome: Evolve karaoke modelling beyond a simple flag to represent audio/CDG pairs and incomplete tracks.

Title: Karaoke Playback Coordination
Key Concepts: Timing; synchronization; interfaces; events
Expected Outcome: Coordinate audio playback state with karaoke graphics timing without coupling it directly to the UI.

Title: MVVM & ViewModels
Key Concepts: MVVM; observable state; commands; binding concepts
Expected Outcome: Expose library, queue, search, and playback state through UI-friendly view models.

Title: First Desktop Library UI
Key Concepts: Data binding; lists; search controls; commands
Expected Outcome: Build an initial Windows interface for browsing and searching the media library.

Title: Now Playing & Karaoke UI
Key Concepts: Playback controls; progress; secondary display concepts; event updates
Expected Outcome: Add now-playing controls and a karaoke-oriented display experience.

Title: Mini Karaoke Player Milestone
Key Concepts: End-to-end integration; packaging readiness; retrospective
Expected Outcome: Combine the strongest components into a small working database-backed karaoke/music player prototype.
Notes: Potential transition point from short challenges into larger application feature tickets.
